detail.longDescription: 🐧 SIGINT // Linux Watch — 2026-11-07 APT, the tool every Debian and Ubuntu box trusts to fetch packages, had a verification-bypass flaw (CVE-2026-109518) that Canonical patched on November 4. An on-path attacker could swap packages after the checks, so run your updates before your mirror gets creative. 🔗 https:// xenospectrum.com/en/apt-verifi cation-bypass-security-fix/ # Linux # OpenSource # FOSS
